$comment: Source for the GitHub backlog. create-issues.mjs turns each epic into a parent issue and each item into a sub-issue. Edit here, then re-run; existing titles are skipped.

milestones.title: M0 · Web UI MVP
milestones.description: Clickable web UI on demo data: every requirement marked built in docs/requirements.md.

milestones.title: M1 · Backend & accounts
milestones.description: Real persistence, sign-in, organizations and server-enforced roles. Replaces browser demo storage.

milestones.title: M2 · Real AI drafting
milestones.description: Swap the mock drafting engine for a grounded LLM service behind the DraftResult contract.

milestones.title: M3 · Documents & QuickBooks
milestones.description: Upload past applications/reports, extract facts, and connect QuickBooks for transactions.

milestones.title: M4 · Reports & automation
milestones.description: Funder exports, auto-drafted reports, email alerts and an audit trail.

epics.title: Epic: Backend & persistence
epics.summary: The web app runs entirely on demo data in the browser (`web/src/store`, `web/src/data/seed.ts`). Add an API and database so organizations keep real data, without changing the UI.

issues.title: Decide backend stack and hosting (ADR)
issues.body:
Write `docs/adr/0001-backend.md` choosing the API runtime, database and hosting.

Inputs:
- Today the site is a static build served from 5820 through the Cloudflare Tunnel (`docs/deploy.md`).
- `web/src/types.ts` is framework-free and meant to be shared with the API.
- `web/src/lib` holds pure domain logic (finance, permissions, drafting) that the server should reuse.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Options compared (e.g. Node API + Postgres on 5820 vs. Cloudflare Workers + D1)
- [ ] Decision covers backups, secrets and how `/api` is routed next to the static site
- [ ] Decision recorded and linked from the README

issues.title: Database schema and migrations for the domain model
issues.body:
Model `Organization`, `User`, `Fact`, `PastDocument`, `Grant` (with `BudgetCategory`, `Question`, `Deadline`), `Transaction` and `Allocation` from `web/src/types.ts`.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Every table scoped by `organization_id`
- [ ] Migrations run from one command in dev and on deploy
- [ ] Seed script loads the current demo organization from `web/src/data/seed.ts`

issues.title: REST API for grants, facts, questions and transactions
issues.body:
CRUD endpoints for the entities the UI edits today, reusing the shared types.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Request/response validation shared with `web/src/types.ts`
- [ ] Grant spending computed server-side with `web/src/lib/finance.ts` in each grant's own funding period
- [ ] Compliance flags (unauthorized category, over budget, nearing limit) returned with transactions
- [ ] API tests in CI

issues.title: Move the web store from browser storage to the API
issues.body:
Replace the in-browser state in `web/src/store/AppStoreProvider.tsx` with API calls while keeping the `useStore()` surface so feature components don't change.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Loading and error states on every page
- [ ] Optimistic updates for edits (fact edits, allocations, answer approval)
- [ ] A demo mode that still runs on seed data with no account

issues.title: Server-side CSV transaction import
issues.body:
The CSV import in `web/src/features/transactions/ImportModal.tsx` parses in the browser. Persist imports through the API.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Duplicate detection (date + amount + vendor) on re-import
- [ ] Import batch recorded so a bad import can be rolled back
- [ ] Clear errors for malformed rows

issues.title: Deploy the API on 5820 with database backups
issues.body:
Extend `deploy/31-grantit.sh` and `deploy/nginx.conf` to run the API behind the tunnel.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] `/api` routed to the API container; static site unchanged
- [ ] Secrets kept out of the repo
- [ ] Nightly database backup included in `srv-backup`, restore tested once
- [ ] `docs/deploy.md` updated

epics.title: Epic: Accounts, organizations & roles
epics.summary: Roles (director, finance, program staff) are simulated in the UI with no sign-in. Add real accounts, organizations and server-enforced permissions.

issues.title: User sign-in
issues.body:
Add sign-in (email magic link or Google) with sessions.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Sign in, sign out and session expiry
- [ ] Signed-out users only see the demo or the sign-in page
- [ ] Role switcher in the UI removed outside demo mode

issues.title: Organizations and team invites
issues.body:
Create an organization on first sign-in and invite teammates from `web/src/features/team/TeamPage.tsx` with a role.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Invite by email with role (director, finance, program)
- [ ] Directors can change roles and remove members
- [ ] Data never crosses organizations (tested)

issues.title: Enforce role permissions on the server
issues.body:
Apply the matrix in `web/src/lib/permissions.ts` (`can`, `canApproveFact`) to every API write, not only in the UI.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Every mutating endpoint checks the action
- [ ] Program staff can only approve program-side facts
- [ ] Tests for each role × action

issues.title: Multi-user approval workflow for facts and answers
issues.body:
Let an organization require a second approver for facts and application answers.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Request review → approve / request changes, with comments
- [ ] Approver cannot be the author when two-person approval is on
- [ ] Pending approvals listed on the dashboard

epics.title: Epic: Grounded AI drafting
epics.summary: `web/src/lib/drafting.ts` is a keyword-matching mock. Replace it with an LLM service that answers only from approved facts and returns the same `DraftResult` (text, citations, missing, blockedBy), so the UI doesn't change.

issues.title: Drafting service behind the DraftResult contract
issues.body:
Server endpoint that drafts an answer to a grant question using only approved facts as context and returns `DraftResult`.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Only facts with `status: approved` from the caller's organization are sent
- [ ] Response cites fact IDs per sentence
- [ ] Funder rules from the grant included as constraints
- [ ] API key held server-side only
- [ ] UI swaps from `draftAnswer` to the endpoint with no component changes

issues.title: Validate citations and reject unsupported claims
issues.body:
After generation, check every sentence cites an approved fact that exists, and flag or drop sentences that don't.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Unknown or unapproved fact IDs are rejected
- [ ] Uncited sentences removed or flagged in the UI
- [ ] Unit tests with fabricated citations

issues.title: Enforce word limits on generated answers
issues.body:
Guarantee answers fit each question's `wordLimit`, trimming at sentence boundaries like `fitToLimit` does today or regenerating shorter.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] No returned answer exceeds its limit
- [ ] Trimming never cuts mid-sentence

issues.title: Report missing information instead of inventing it
issues.body:
Populate `missing` (gaps with no fact) and `blockedBy` (facts that exist but aren't approved) from the model.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Gaps shown as the existing 'missing information' chips
- [ ] One click from a gap to create the fact in the knowledge base

issues.title: Grounding evaluation suite
issues.body:
A repeatable eval over the demo organization's questions and facts.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Scores citation accuracy, unsupported-claim rate, word-limit compliance and gap detection
- [ ] Runs from one command; results saved for comparison across prompt/model changes

issues.title: Match the organization's tone and writing style
issues.body:
Use the organization's style profile (see the documents epic) when drafting.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Style examples passed as guidance, never as a source of facts
- [ ] Eval shows no drop in grounding with style on

issues.title: Reuse relevant answers from past applications
issues.body:
Suggest prior approved answers for similar questions and adapt them, without copying blindly.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Similar past answers shown with their grant and date
- [ ] Adapted answers still cite current approved facts; stale numbers flagged

issues.title: Usage limits and cost logging for drafting
issues.body:
Track tokens and cost per organization and rate-limit drafting.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Per-organization daily limit with a clear message when reached
- [ ] Usage visible in Settings

epics.title: Epic: Knowledge base documents
epics.summary: Past applications and reports are a list with no files, and the style profile is static. Store real documents and turn them into reviewable facts and a style profile.

issues.title: Upload past applications and reports
issues.body:
Upload PDF/DOCX files against `PastDocument` records.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] File storage scoped to the organization
- [ ] Preview and download from the knowledge base
- [ ] Size/type limits enforced

issues.title: Extract candidate facts from uploaded documents
issues.body:
Pull mission, program, beneficiary and outcome statements from uploads into facts with `status: pending` and a `source` link.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Extracted facts never auto-approved
- [ ] Each fact links back to the document and page
- [ ] Duplicates of existing facts flagged

issues.title: Build a writing style profile from approved examples
issues.body:
Replace the static style profile with one derived from documents staff mark as good examples.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Staff choose which documents count as examples
- [ ] Profile is viewable and editable in the knowledge base

epics.title: Epic: QuickBooks & expenditure audit
epics.summary: Transactions come from CSV only. Connect QuickBooks Online and keep a full history of expenditure changes.

issues.title: Connect QuickBooks Online
issues.body:
OAuth connection to QuickBooks Online from Settings.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Connect, reconnect and disconnect
- [ ] Tokens stored encrypted and refreshed automatically
- [ ] Works against the QuickBooks sandbox in dev

issues.title: Sync QuickBooks transactions and map accounts to categories
issues.body:
Incremental sync of expenses into `Transaction`, with a saved mapping from QuickBooks accounts/classes to grant spending categories.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Re-sync never duplicates or overwrites manual allocations
- [ ] Unmapped accounts land in the review queue

issues.title: Audit trail for expenditure changes and approvals
issues.body:
Record who changed an allocation, category or approval, when, and the before/after values.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] History panel in the allocation drawer
- [ ] Audit log exportable per grant
- [ ] Entries are append-only

epics.title: Epic: Reports, exports & alerts
epics.summary: Reports export as CSV and alerts are in-app only. Add funder-ready exports, auto-drafted reports and email alerts.

issues.title: Export applications to DOCX and PDF
issues.body:
Export a grant's approved answers in question order, with word counts, to DOCX and PDF.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Per-funder template option (headings, fonts, cover page)
- [ ] Export blocked or warned when validation finds unanswered questions or over-limit answers

issues.title: PDF expenditure report per grant
issues.body:
Add a PDF alongside the existing CSV in `web/src/lib/report.ts`: budget vs. actual by category for the grant's own reporting period.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Matches the figures on the grant's budget tab
- [ ] Includes the reporting period and generated date

issues.title: Auto-draft narrative and financial reports before deadlines
issues.body:
When a report deadline is near, draft the narrative from approved facts and the financial section from grant spending.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Drafts created N days before the deadline (configurable)
- [ ] Same grounding and citation rules as application drafting

issues.title: Email alerts for deadlines and projected overruns
issues.body:
Email the right people about upcoming deadlines (`web/src/lib/deadlines.ts`) and categories projected to exceed budget.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Per-user notification settings
- [ ] Weekly digest option
- [ ] Alerts link straight to the grant

epics.title: Epic: Quality & operations
epics.summary: CI runs type-check, lint, unit tests and build. Add end-to-end coverage, monitoring and an accessibility pass.

issues.title: End-to-end tests for core flows
issues.body:
Playwright tests in CI for: create grant → add questions → draft and approve answers; import CSV → allocate → see budget flags; approve a fact.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Runs on every PR
- [ ] Traces uploaded on failure

issues.title: Error monitoring for web and API
issues.body:
Add error reporting with source maps and release tagging.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Frontend and API errors reported with the deployed commit (`version.txt`)
- [ ] Alert on new errors

issues.title: Accessibility audit and fixes
issues.body:
Audit keyboard navigation, focus management in drawers/modals, contrast and screen-reader labels.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Automated axe checks in the E2E suite
- [ ] Drawers and modals trap and restore focus
